hints.title: Fix Middle Soldier
hints.text: Iterate through each soldier j as the middle member of a team (i < j < k).

hints.title: Count Smaller and Larger on Both Sides
hints.text: For fixed j, count how many elements to the left are smaller or larger than rating[j], and similarly to the right.

hints.title: Multiply Combinations
hints.text: Teams with ascending order are left_smaller * right_larger. Teams with descending order are left_larger * right_smaller.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numTeams(self, rating: list[int]) -> int:
        n = len(rating)
        teams = 0
        for j in range(n):
            left_less = sum(1 for i in range(j) if rating[i] < rating[j])
            left_greater = j - left_less
            right_less = sum(1 for k in range(j + 1, n) if rating[k] < rating[j])
            right_greater = (n - 1 - j) - right_less
            teams += left_less * right_greater + left_greater * right_less
        return teams
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all triplets (i, j, k) directly takes cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixing the middle element j reduces combinations to O(N^2) with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate fixes middle soldier and multiplies left/right comparative counts.
